findings.summary: Carried over (declared, unfixed): OnBeforePlay runs and broadcasts its warnings before WritePlaySnapshot validates the request, with the unvalidated client scenePath as info.scene
findings.scenario: WritePlaySnapshot with a bad or unresolvable scenePath: every OnBeforePlay hook runs and its warnings go out as Public extensionOutput events naming a scene that is never played, then the command fails

findings.summary: Carried over (declared deviation): an extension's own asset write never reaches any OnAssetsChanged hook, because NoteAssetWritten refreshes the index so no later poll reports it
findings.scenario: Extension A calls Editor.Assets.WriteText('res://x.txt'); extension B's OnAssetsChanged never sees res://x.txt, while it does see a client's identical write

findings.summary: Carried over (declared, unfixed): the watcher never retries a file that failed on an id clash when the owning file changes, and the untouched extension always wins whatever the file order
findings.scenario: a.lua and b.lua both declare id X; edit b.lua, so it fails on the clash; rename the id in a.lua; b.lua stays Failed until b.lua itself is touched or there is a full reload

confirmedDelta: delta = 1 test-only commit (EditorExtensionHooksTests.cpp) + clean master merge (merge-tree tree equal), verified by orchestrator
